steps.content: I've heard your little garden was attacked recently. Paradeisos is finally coming after you, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Don't drag us into your battle with Paradeisos. We're not your tools anymore.
Aha, think your hands are clean now? Paradeisos doesn't care. You'll always be an Underground rat in their eyes. They've been after you for a while now...
We founded this group. We saved you and helped you get your revenge... Your rebirth is a gift from us...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: No! Not you. Vengeance wasn't what saved me, my family was. I was saved by her and everyone...
And Paradeisos will wipe them out soon. Neither your boss nor your family can defend against that... One day, and you know that day is coming soon... Unless...
Let's make a deal... The administrator of Paradeisos, the one leading your eradication... He's exposed himself...
...Together, we'll find him. I'll grant you enough power to safeguard your new life.

The bullets are piercing into Garofano's body. The Mania within her lessens the impact, but can't cancel it out completely. Her senses are blurring, only the stubborn determination fueled by fear keeps her bolting.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Can't... get caught again... Can't be used again...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I... must not become bait and endanger them...
